name: DryRun PostgreSQL MCP
summary: Offline PostgreSQL schema CLI and MCP server for linting, migration safety, and query validation.
use_cases: check migration safety with lock analysis

capabilities.label: Check migration safety and lock types
Diff snapshots and detect schema drift
Capture and diff pg_stat_statements query stats

usage_guide.open_hint: From a project folder that contains a dryrun schema snapshot, run `dryrun lint` to check the schema.

features.title: Lint PostgreSQL schemas offline
steps: Open a terminal in your project folder that holds the schema snapshot.
Run `dryrun lint` to list errors and warnings for each table.

features.title: Check how safe a migration is
steps: Write your migration SQL to a file such as <migration.sql>.
Run `dryrun check migration <migration.sql>` to see the lock type and how long it is held.

features.title: Check queries against your schema
steps: Save your query to a file such as <query.sql>.
Run `dryrun check query <query.sql>` to confirm it is valid for the schema.

features.title: Compare schema snapshots to find drift
steps: Run `dryrun snapshot diff <snapshot1> <snapshot2>` with two snapshot IDs to list the changes between them.
